title: The Scarf Incident
letter_points: A pigeon pooped on Arya's favourite scarf, in broad daylight, in front of everyone.
Arya's photo of it is blurry.
Pigeons are hard to tell apart.

blurry_photo.text: Arya's blurry photo of the incident.

felix_in_photo.text: Alex spotted Felix in the photo, right behind Arya.

pigeon_photo.text: Felix's photo of the pigeon. Find this pigeon at the plaza!
